missing_fields: No absolute pressure or numerical quench temperature is reported.
No particle-size statistics for this direct-route sample are reported in the cited Figure 1 passage.
Matched Supporting Information is not admitted/read in this extraction scope.
No atomically refined specimen-specific CIF or coordinate file is supplied by this source.
No optical/electrical property measurement is reported in the reviewed main article.
conflicts: The source describes Ni3S4 product and metallic Ni byproduct; relative Ni amount changes with Ni:S ratio. No quantitative phase fraction is reported.

The paper reports qualitative screening outcomes (>220 °C insoluble black material, <180 °C very low yield, TOP/octenoic acid higher quality than tributylphosphine); the screen does not provide complete per-condition recipes and is not represented as extra synthesis records.
